title.narrative: Applications of Industry-urban Symbiosis and Green Chemistry for Low Emission and Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs)-Free Industrial Development in Thailand

description.narrative: ..Applications of Industry-urban Symbiosis and Green Chemistry for Low Emission and Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs)-Free Industrial Development in Thailand. Objective: To reduce greenhouse gas emissions, as well as releases of POPs, Mercury and other harmful chemicals from industries and towns through the application of urban-industrial symbiosis and green chemistry technology .
